name: kingshot-tools
description: Research Kingshot events and transfers, generate reproducible reports, query packs, and calculate CP value.

interface.shortDescription: Research events, transfers, and reproducible Kingshot reports.
interface.longDescription: Research Kingshot event rules and transfer groups; compare kingdom Power, Mystic, and KvK strength; audit visible player names for Chinese-language signals without inferring from alliance tags; verify report inputs; and generate reproducible event-pack or migration reports.
defaultPrompt: 查詢 Kingshot 活動的玩法、計分、里程碑與時程。
先確認伺服器進度、已購禮包、剩餘資源與獎品內容，再以不加購基準為 Kingshot 活動產生邊際 CP 報告。
查詢 Kingshot 禮包的價格與內容。
計算這個 Kingshot 禮包的 CP 值。
調查 Kingshot 轉組王國、中文玩家名稱與高端強度，產生可重建的排序清單和移民報告。
